newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB drops February 96/97 wheat, durum, barley PROs.
newsitem.headline: CWB drops February 96/97 wheat, durum, barley PROs.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board said Thursday it had dropped its February Pool Return Outlook wheat, durum and barley price forecasts for the 1996/97 (August/July) crop year.

Wheat PROs were down C$1.00 to C$7.00 per tonne, durum was reduced C$2.00 to C$4.00 and feed barley fell C$1.00 to C$4.00 while the CWB said designated barley was unchanged as it narrowed the price range to bring the top end down C$5.00.
The PROs are a monthly CWB estimate of world prices.
Benchmark No1 Canada Western Red Spring Wheat PROs fell C$2.00 to C$7.00 to the C$193-C$208 range from C$195-C$215.
Grain movement delays over the past several months and a slower-than-expected recovery continue to hinder nearby selling opportunities, the CWB said.
This has limited the volume of the pool that can be priced prior to the entry of new crop onto the market, which reflects lower prices, it added.
The delays are also resulting in additional demurrage costs. The CWB has said it incurred more than C$15 million in fines since early January.
Durum wheat and feed barley prices were lowered slightly because values softened somewhat, the CWB added.
Pool returns in Canadian dollars per tonne based on grain in store St. Lawrence or Vancouver:

CWRS=Canada Western Spring Wheat. CPSR=Canada Prairie Spring Red. CPSW=Canada Prairie Spring White. CWRW= Canada Western Red Winter. CWES=Canada Western Extra Strong. CWSWS=Canada Western Soft White Spring. CWF=Canada Western Feed. CWAD=Canada Western Amber Durum. CW=Canada Western. SS=Special Select.
